_comment: Instance data of helpers/decision-register.cjs (PostToolUse + PreToolUse on AskUserQuestion). register = the ONE versioned file every answer the operator gives through the question tool is appended to (relative to the brain root; commit it like any ledger). model = the small model that judges whether a new question asks a matter an earlier answer already decided. min_score = word prefilter threshold (share of rare words). enabled false switches both hooks off. First fill from history: node core/helpers/decision-register.cjs --backfill.
